poc_results: Total tokens consumed (trial): ~6.1M tokens across 3 weeks
Observed average latency (hosted API, 95th): 420ms for chat paths (prompt ~280 tokens / completion ~420 tokens)
Median latency: 220ms; p50 under 200ms for short prompts
Average QPS (business hours): 110-140 qps; sustained peak (campaign simulation): 360 qps for ~20 min
Streaming usage: 12% of chat requests (live agent augmentation)
Embeddings share: 28% of calls (product search indexing + similarity), avg 128 tokens per embedding request
Reranking batch jobs: periodic offline rerank (low qps) but high token per job (avg 1.2k tokens)
Error rate: <0.5% 5xx during trial; most retries due to client timeouts during peak burst
workload_profile: Mixed workload: 60% interactive chat (support + agent assist), 28% embeddings for search/recs, 12% reranking/summary. Peak-oriented traffic around campaign windows (expected 2-3x baseline). Sensitive to p95 latency spikes >500ms. Heavy month-over-month growth projected as feature ships to more customers.
traffic_forecast_summary: Requested forecast to produce 6-month runway for committed capacity. Customer-provided baseline: 120 qps avg (mar 2026) -> expected 220 qps avg by Aug 2026 with campaign multipliers causing 450 qps peak. Conservative committed target: sustained 350 qps with burst to 600 qps for short windows. Finance prefers step-up commit (1 quarter notice).
qps_and_concurrency_estimates: Baseline (now): 120 qps -> concurrency observed ~18-24 active requests (avg response ~350 tokens total)
Sustained target (6mo): 350 qps -> expected concurrency 55-70 depending on streaming share
Peak bursts: 600 qps for 5-30 minutes -> requires autoscale/burst capacity or fallback to smaller model variants
Embedding throughput: 34 req/s during reindex windows; can be scheduled off-peak with batching (batch size 16-64)
token_mix_and_request_shape: Chat: prompt avg 280 tokens, completion avg 420 tokens (including system + user + tooling calls)
Embeddings: avg 128 tokens per document, 28% of calls, usually batched by client for indexing
Reranking/summaries: median job size 1.2k tokens, executed as occasional high-cost operations
Streaming vs non-streaming: ~12% streaming; streaming requests have longer wall-time but reduce perceived latency for UX
capacity_recommendation_summary: SE recommends starting Dedicated with a 'medium' pool sized for sustained 350 qps (model mix as above) with 20% headroom: equivalent to 4 medium GPU nodes with autoscale policy to add 2 nodes for short bursts. Suggest configuring canary routing (5-10%) and automatic fallback to quantized / cheaper model for non-critical traffic. Include reserved burst credits for marketing events.
performance_sla_needs: Customer requests 99th percentile latency SLO of <600ms for chat on dedicated; request clarification on SLO for embeddings and rerank jobs. Wants transparent token-level cost breakdown for cost allocation to product teams.
cost_sensitivity_and_pricing_notes: Mid-market price sensitivity: looking for committed discount if ARR >= $75k. Finance prefers quarterly ramp rather than annual all-in. Interested in Transparent per-token pricing plus fixed monthly reservation for baseline. Ask: appendix with model-variant unit economics (per-token across small/medium/large nodes).
security_and_compliance_summary: Must support SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation (in-place), audit logging for admin actions, and optional EU data residency for EU customers. Legal reviewing DPA; add KMS key management for encryption-at-rest. No requirement for air-gapped on initial rollout.
